authorization: Simone, 14 November 2026: install single-book paper tracking including no-bets, ROI/results in Monitor and weekly; separate paired comparison, prevent double counting, no new alerts, live unchanged.
hypothesis: Retain otherwise valid opportunities when only one complete fresh bookmaker vector is available; descriptive current-gate evidence, not evidence of a gate improvement.
population: Existing Count (primary) and Direct (secondary) ATP Most Aces forecasts. At least one source-valid complete current three-way vector after all configured source checks, but fewer than two quality-valid books (overround <=1.2). If exactly one quality-valid book exists, use that book and retain excluded high-margin vectors. If none exists, retain the highest-EV vector as a no-bet. EV/confidence/own-gap failures remain no-bets. No new single-book record after the same model/edition/round/player pair was already captured in paired.
timing: First prospective observation after enabled_at; no historical backfill. Original forecast <=6h, provider quote <=30min, observation before exact kickoff. Native IDs/edition/round, player orientation and receipt artifact hashes required; no date substitution.
reference: Selected book no-vig probabilities for descriptive calibration only, not consensus. Gates coincide when exactly one complete book exists. No gate contrast is claimed for single-book or limited-coverage rows; keep paired denominators unchanged.
selection: Existing current-gate thresholds on the only quality-valid book: EV >=8%, overround <=1.2, own-book max gap <=20pp and unchanged confidence/non-price exclusions. Raw odds and unchanged p. Without any quality-valid book, highest-EV vector is recorded as a no-bet with OVERROUND_GT_20. 1u paper only if selected, zero real stake.
outcomes: Existing exact OnCourt edition/round/participant join and bookmaker retirement/void rules. Original observations immutable; outcomes separate. All no-bets settled for calibration; no-bets and voids excluded from settled stake/ROI.
overlap: First single-book row immutable if a later >=2-book paired decision appears. Later paired capture uses its own then-current prices and time. Derived overlap by model/edition/round/player IDs; separate denominators and charts, aggregate_eligible=false. Never sum with paired or existing source-row records as a portfolio.
evaluation: Prospective only, no fit/development/test search. Three-class summed Brier and natural log loss on all exactly settled observations, selected subset separately; current-gate W/L, settled 1u stake, P/L, ROI, pending/overdue and daily drawdown. No comparison-improvement or profitability claim.
uncertainty: Descriptive only; review at 50/100 independent fixtures per model, not summed across models. Cluster by tournament edition; no conventional cluster interval with fewer10 editions. Adequacy requires precision review; no automatic promotion.
reporting: Two cards within existing Most Aces family, profit histories and calibration; labelled single-book and non-additive to >=2-book paired or source-row views. Existing snapshot and weekly workflow only; no new alerts or schedules.
